It is recorded as proposed, not ruled: A currency is reached by three routes: the currency a sale was paid in, or one of the two currencies of an exchange rate — its source (the currency it converts from; for a sale, the currency the amounts are stored in) or its target (the currency it converts to; for a sale, the sale's own currency). The answer says which currency it used.

sme_questions.question: Is the rule “Customer.active_on_the_reference_date” right? The reference date is the date the question states, else the data's own "now", and the answer says which. "Customers" with no other word means the active customers; "registered" customers are every customer on the register, whether valid on that date or not. Active customers are not the same set as customers who have bought something — each can hold people the other does not.
